description: issue #688: the ACTIVE half of the pair -- `when`, `every`, `on_key`, and `on_click` are profile block-heads. Redefining any of the four with `define` raises `ol-reserved-word`, and all four are asserted in one program so a fix that reserved only the name a single fixture happened to pick cannot pass. Its twin `block-heads-reserved-under-core-only` runs the SAME source with Core Language alone and expects the same diagnostics, because spec/grammar.md:412 makes the reservation INVARIANT under the profile set rather than scoped by it. It takes the pair to say that; either fixture alone is satisfied by an implementation answering the same way for the wrong reason. `message` is absent from the diagnostics below, as it is from its twin: this fixture does not set `compareMessages`, so the harness compares its diagnostics on identity alone (issue #1025) -- and supplying a `message` without that flag is now a fixture ERROR rather than silently-ignored data, so nothing can sit here asserting nothing; the learner-facing wording is pinned by unit tests instead (`packages/parser/src/checker-reserved-word.test.mjs:236`). This is a check-mode fixture: it proves static legality only and does not execute.
